title: Sr. Sales Executive - Tile Adhesive
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive tertiary sales of Tile Adhesive through architect
* Regularly visit retail counters to generate demand and improve product movement
* Ensure adequate product availability, visibility, and merchandising at retail outlets
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with dealers, retailers, contractors, and other channel partners
* Identify and onboard new retailers and sales points within the assigned territory
* Support order generation, follow-up, and secondary-to-tertiary sales conversion
* Execute local promotional activities, schemes, and product campaigns
* Track competitor activities, pricing, product movement, and market trends
* Collect market feedback on customer preferences, demand, pricing, and competition
* Achieve assigned sales and coverage targets through effective field execution
* Maintain regular market visit reports and provide updates to the reporting manager

**Required Qualifications**

* Any Graduate; MBA in Sales & Marketing preferred

**Experience & Industry Background**

* 2–4 years of experience in sales
* Experience in Tile Adhesive, Building Materials, Construction Chemicals, Tiles, or related industries preferred
* Candidates with strong retail and dealer network exposure in Surat market will be preferred

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong retail and tertiary sales orientation
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Market development and field execution capability
* Basic understanding of building materials and construction products
* Negotiation and convincing skills
* Result-oriented, disciplined, and target-driven
* Ability to work independently in a field-sales environment

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in Building Materials industry?

Work Location: In person

title: Salse executive
description:
WE ARE HIRING!Sales & Marketing Executive – HoReCa Division

**Company:** Mithash Foods Pvt. Ltd.  
**Website:** https://mithashnutri.com/  
**Location:** Atkot, Rajkot, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Field Sales + Office Work

**Job Location : 1.Surat**  
**2,Ahamdabad**

**3,Atkot**

About the Role

Mithash Foods Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales & Marketing Executive to expand our HoReCa business. The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and building strong relationships with hotels, restaurants, cafés, caterers and other food-service businesses.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop new customers in the HoReCa segment.
* Visit hotels, restaurants, cafés, bakeries, caterers and commercial kitchens.
* Promote and sell company products, including spices, flours, pulses, rice, cooking oil, sauces and other food essentials.
* Generate leads, arrange product samples and follow up on quotations.
* Build relationships with chefs, purchase managers, hotel owners and restaurant owners.
* Develop bulk orders, repeat business and long-term customer relationships.
* Identify distributors, wholesalers and institutional buyers.
* Conduct market research and track competitor pricing.
* Maintain customer databases, sales reports and monthly targets.

Requirements

* Qualification: Graduate or equivalent; candidates with relevant sales experience are preferred.
* Experience in FMCG, food products, HoReCa or B2B sales will be an advantage.
* Good communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and customer meetings.
* Knowledge of the local market and Gujarati/Hindi communication is preferred.
* Freshers with strong sales skills may also apply.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary + performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding food business.
* Career growth in B2B and HoReCa sales.
* Exposure to hotels, restaurants, cafés and institutional customers.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹33,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Business Executive - Surat
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial growth and build strong, trusted relationships with healthcare partners across Surat. Your role will focus on designing and delivering territory plans that drive business results and support better patient outcomes. We value clear communication, integrity, curiosity, and practical commercial thinking. This opportunity offers meaningful impact, continuous learning, and collaboration with talented colleagues united by a shared mission to get ahead of disease through science and technology. Join us to grow your career while making a real difference. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Build and maintain trusted, professional relationships with healthcare professionals, hospital teams, and institutional partners across Surat. - Design, execute, and monitor territory business plans that achieve commercial objectives and improve patient care. - Conduct professional visits and educational meetings to share clear, evidence-based information responsibly. - Collect market and customer insights to refine strategies, enhance performance, and address local needs. - Collaborate with colleagues across functions to meet customer expectations and ensure smooth, timely delivery. - Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and applicable local regulations. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution; background in science, pharmacy, or medicine is an advantage. - 1 to 3 years of experience in customer-facing roles such as sales, fieldwork, or account management. - Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and relevant local languages used in Surat (e.g., Gujarati, Hindi). - Comfortable using everyday digital tools, including Word, Excel, and mobile reporting applications. - Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory. - Customer-focused mindset with integrity and commitment to ethical conduct. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Experience in healthcare, hospital, or pharmaceutical field roles. - Ability to explain clinical or scientific information clearly to diverse audiences. - Planning, organisational, and analytical skills to monitor and improve territory outcomes. - Experience organising professional meetings or educational events. - Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team. - Fluency in additional regional languages relevant to Surat and surrounding areas. Work pattern and location This role is on-site in Surat with regular travel across the assigned territory. Most of your time will be spent in the field meeting customers and healthcare teams. Some flexible time for administrative tasks is possible. Ready to apply? If this role feels right for you, we want to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a short note explaining why this opportunity appeals to you. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people who value inclusion to apply. Join us and help unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

**Skills**

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Assistant District Sales Manager- Surat Location
description:
**Company Description**  

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!


Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.


Our Mission


We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

 **Job Description**  

The focus of the Assistant District Sales Manager is on achieving results that are aligned with the overall organization and it's strategic goals. Initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, are the keys to achieving the performance objectives of the District Sales Executive role at Expeditors.


The ADSM orchestrates involvement of multiple people in our Sales process, so that new customer revenue is consistently secured for our district office and Expeditors network. The job environment is flexible, constantly changing, and provides growth opportunity, recognition and reward for the achievement of business results. This position reports to the District Sales Manager.

**Key Deliverables**


These are the minimum results expected from a successful District Sales Executive:

* Manage an assigned territory and demonstrate extensive knowledge of potential customers and competitors in this area
* Timely data entry in our Customer Relationship Management tool
* Orchestrate customer / branch relationships and collaborate with regional Product, Service, Geo, and Knowledge Management resources
* Participate in the creation of value\-added solutions for customer's logistics needs, including supporting diagrams and cost\-benefit calculations
* Support the transition of new accounts through customer introductions, information transfer, and securing any necessary customer paperwork. When needed, support AR (accounts receivable) collection.
* Attend training \& development sessions to continue developing selling skills and updating Expeditors Product and Service knowledge
* Involvement in local trade groups, as directed by the District Sales Manager
* Take on additional assignments as required, supporting company needs

  

**Qualifications**  

* Must have at least 3\-5 years of Sales experience in Freight Forwarding industry
* The ability to meet with customers off\-site on a regular basis
* Oral and written proficiency in the English language
* Strong problem solving, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work productively both individually and in a team environment
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Self\-motivated with ability to work in a fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Comfortable with regular data entry on a laptop computer
* Strong rapport and relationship\-building focused
* Empowered to make quick decisions in response to changing conditions
* Extroverted, confident, enthusiastic and persuasive
* Influences others to action
* Timeliness and accountability for results

  

**Additional Information**  

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus
